web_mfa_intro: When it's on, signing in takes your password and a code from an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator. Someone who gets hold of your password still can't sign in.
web_mfa_required_body: Two-step verification is required for your account, so it can't be turned off.
web_mfa_codes_low: Only {1} of 10 recovery codes left. Get new ones so you can still sign in if you lose your phone.
web_mfa_codes_renewed: You have new recovery codes. The old ones no longer work.
web_mfa_setup_title: Add ShikkhokPlus to your authenticator app
web_mfa_setup_body: Scan this code with an authenticator app, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
web_mfa_qr_label: QR code to add ShikkhokPlus to your authenticator app
web_mfa_key_label: Can't scan it? Type this key into the app instead:
web_mfa_copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
web_mfa_confirm_label: Enter the 6-digit code the app now shows
web_mfa_codes_warning: Save these now. Each code works once, and they're the only way to sign in if you lose the phone with your authenticator app. They won't be shown again.
web_mfa_codes_where: Keep them somewhere safe that isn't your phone, such as a password manager or a printed sheet.
web_mfa_off_body: Signing in will need only your password again. Enter a code from your authenticator app to confirm.
web_mfa_renew_body: Your current recovery codes will stop working. Enter a code from your authenticator app to confirm.
web_mfa_signin_body: Your account has two-step verification on. Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for ShikkhokPlus.
web_mfa_recovery_help: One of the 10 codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification. Each one works once.
web_mfa_recovery_wrong: That recovery code isn't right, or it has already been used.
web_mfa_challenge_time: Finish within 5 minutes, or signing in starts again.
web_mfa_prompt_title: Protect your account with two-step verification
web_mfa_prompt_body: It keeps your fee and student records safe if someone takes over your SIM.
